# Screen each order

As a shop owner I want every new order screened so that stolen cards don't empty the stock.

## Acceptance criteria

- Given a new order, when it is placed, then sku and quantity are sent to Northwind Pay.
- Given an accepted order, when it is saved, then the orders row holds fraud_verdict.
- Given any order, when it is placed, then it is logged.
